title: 2.8.2.7-dev commit 5c9cd84c2, error when changing eros Pod
body:
I just switched to AAPS 2.8.2.7-dev my eros pod for the first time. Deactivating the Eros Pod worked fine. When activating the new Eros Pod I first got the screen that I should fill the Eros Pod with insulin for three days, then I pressed continue and the screen was frozen but I heard it click and the profile was transferred and the message APP close or wait came up, I confirmed this with wait. Now the screen jumped to where I was supposed to put the pod, I did this and continued. Now the screen was frozen again but I could hear the catheter being shot and the same message came up as before, close APP or wait. OmniPod Tab looks good, test tone issued Pod beeps.

1. main tab catheter and insulin time was not updated.

2. as soon as new information is sent to the Pod, I get the error message 'Data is coming from another pump. Change pump driver' and the main tab is not updated in any way, bolus or basal.


In the meantime I switched back to the master branch, eros Pod runs as usual in the master branch.

Here are some more screenshots.
Greetings Thomas
